x1.description: Input tensor or array-like structure to test.

x2.description: Values against which each element of `x1` is tested. Can be a tensor, list, or scalar.

assume_unique.description: Boolean (default: False). If True, assumes both `x1` and `x2` contain only unique elements. This can speed up the computation. If False, duplicates will be handled correctly but may impact performance.

invert.description: A boolean (default: False). If True, inverts the result. Entries will be `True` where `x1` elements are not in `x2`.

output.description: A boolean tensor of the same shape as `x1` indicating element-wise membership in `x2`.
